newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nepal postpones diesel, kerosene closing to Jan 12.
newsitem.headline: Nepal postpones diesel, kerosene closing to Jan 12.

text.p: State-owned Nepal Oil Corp (NOC) has delayed the closing date of its tender to buy superior kerosene and high speed diesel to January 12, industry sources said on Thursday.
Sources said NOC last week issued a revision to its tender stating that due to "unavoidable reasons" the closing date was postponed to January 12 with offers valid until January 14.
The original tender closed on January 7 with offers valid to January 10. No offers has been submitted by the January 7 deadline, traders said.
NPC is seeking to buy 30,000-tonnes of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel for February 11-20 delivery on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
Offers are to be made on the basis of delivery to Madras/Vizag, Madras/Haldia, Paradeep, or Paradeep/Haldia on the Indian east coast.
NPC tender buy 30,000-tonnes of kerosene is for February 1-20 delivery on a c-and-f basis for delivery to Madras/Vizag or Madras/Haldia also on the Indian east coast.
NOC last bought diesel and kerosene for delivery in November at $232.80 per tonne and $249.50 per tonne, respectively, on a c-and-f east coast basis.
